summary: Perrigo Company plc filed an 8-K announcing the completion of the sale of its Dermacosmetics Business to an affiliate of Karo Healthcare AB, managed by KKR. The transaction closed on April 30, 2026, with a cash payment of €305.6 million, including net working capital adjustments, and up to €27.0 million in contingent consideration over three years. The board recommended the sale, though no specific advisors were named. The deal was executed via a Master Sale and Purchase Agreement with Kairos Bidco AB. Watch for further updates on the contingent earn-out and potential use of proceeds by Perrigo.
